attributes.board_name: Utah Division of Professional Licensing (DOPL) - Physician Assistant Licensing Board

rules.accepted_credit_types: Category 1 as established by ACCME (incl. AAPA-approved programs); other nationally recognized healthcare-accredited programs related to PA practice; up to 15% via volunteer service (4 h = 1 h CME)
rules.alternatives: Documentation of current NCCPA certification fulfills the 34 Category 1 hours (and the psychiatry CAQ CME).
rules.audit_note: Keep documentation for two years after the close of the licensure cycle.

topics.who: All PAs: view the DOPL suicide prevention video each cycle (Utah Code 58-70a-304, 58-1-601)
Controlled substance prescribers with Schedule II/III opioid, hypnotic or stimulant authority; course with post-test
Controlled substance prescribers: one-time SBIRT class (licensing periods after Jan 1, 2024); counts as the 3.5 h prescribing CE for that period

rules.notes: PA licenses expire May 31 of even years (R156-1-308a). Mental health PAs also need CAQ psychiatry CME; medical cannabis recommenders extra CE. Unclear if NCCPA also covers the 6 non-Category-1 hours. DOPL site blocked by Cloudflare.
rules.legal_basis: Utah Admin. Code R156-70a-304; Utah Code 58-70a-304; Utah Code 58-37-303
